text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] At the end of the battle, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, add this card to its owner’s hand.

qa.answer: Yes, you can add it to your hand.
qa.question: Can I add this card to my hand even if this card's [Security] effect doesn't delete an opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less?

qa.answer: Yes, you add it to your hand.
qa.question: Do I use the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Security] effect to add this card to the hand even if the "if" condition in the 2nd process isn't met?
